description: Housing stock and household condition data from the English Housing Survey (EHS), updated annually. Note: some data collected by calendar year, other data by financial year.

datasets.name: Dwellings Occupied & Vacant
datasets.description: Total occupied and vacant dwellings in England (includes PRS estimates)
datasets.frequency: Annual (not part of core EHS release)
datasets.notes: Includes private rented sector estimates. Published separately from main EHS.

datasets.name: Households by Tenure
datasets.description: Number of households in England by tenure type (owner-occupied, privately rented, social rented)

datasets.name: Households by Tenure (%)
datasets.description: Proportion of households in England by tenure type

datasets.name: Household Tenure by Region
datasets.description: Proportion of households by tenure broken down by English region
datasets.notes: Households Report: Profile of Households chapter.

datasets.name: Mean Weekly Rents by Tenure
datasets.description: Mean weekly rent by tenure type, with London and England (excl. London) breakdowns
datasets.notes: Households Report: Profile of Households chapter.

datasets.name: Median Weekly Rents by Tenure
datasets.description: Median weekly rent by tenure type, with London and England (excl. London) breakdowns

datasets.name: Mortgage / Rent as % of Income
datasets.description: Mortgage or rent payments as a proportion of household income (excluding housing benefit)

datasets.name: Age of Property by Tenure
datasets.description: Distribution of dwellings by age band and tenure type
datasets.notes: Headline report: Housing Stock tables. Full trend data available but limited years published.

datasets.name: Rural / Urban Property by Tenure (%)
datasets.description: Proportion of dwellings in rural vs urban areas, by tenure
datasets.notes: Limited years published in trend data.

datasets.name: Non-Decent Homes by Tenure (%)
datasets.description: Proportion of homes failing the Decent Homes Standard by tenure

datasets.name: HHSRS Category 1 Hazards by Tenure (%)
datasets.description: Proportion of homes with a Category 1 hazard under the Housing Health & Safety Rating System, by tenure

datasets.name: Damp Problems by Tenure (%)
datasets.description: Proportion of homes with damp problems by tenure type
datasets.notes: Housing Stock Annex. Limited years published.

datasets.name: Energy Efficiency Band by Tenure (%)
datasets.description: Proportion of homes by EPC energy efficiency band (A-G) and tenure type
datasets.notes: Individual years only (2007–2024 in annual steps).
